description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of the ModuleFilterDefinition class in the 'org.openmrs.module.filter' package. It tests the retrieval of filter definitions from XML configurations within modules, including cases with missing configurations, empty filter elements, and filters with initialization parameters.

classes.name: ModuleFilterDefinitionTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying the filtering configuration retrieval logic within OpenMRS modules.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML string into a Document object used for module configuration.
